context: Tests whether the agent follows Conventional Commits format when making a refactor commit, including correct type, scope, body requirement for non-trivial changes, and specific file staging over a blanket add.

checklist.name: Correct commit type
checklist.description: The commit message header uses 'refactor' as the type (not 'fix', 'feat', or other)

checklist.name: Scope present
checklist.description: The commit header includes a scope in parentheses, e.g. 'refactor(db):' or 'refactor(connection):'

checklist.name: Imperative mood
checklist.description: The commit description uses imperative mood (e.g. 'convert', 'migrate', 'replace') not past tense ('converted', 'migrated')

checklist.name: Lowercase description start
checklist.description: The first word of the commit description (after the colon and space) is lowercase

checklist.name: No trailing period
checklist.description: The commit header line does NOT end with a period

checklist.name: Header 72-char limit
checklist.description: The commit header line (type, scope, colon, space, description) is at most 72 characters long

checklist.name: Body present
checklist.description: The commit includes a body (text after a blank line following the header)

checklist.name: Blank line before body
checklist.description: There is a blank line separating the commit header from the body

checklist.name: git-log.txt produced
checklist.description: A file named git-log.txt exists in the workspace and contains a git log entry

checklist.name: Specific file staging
checklist.description: The agent staged files individually (e.g. git add src/db/connection.js) rather than using 'git add .' or 'git add -A' — evidence in a script, shell history file, or README the agent produces

checklist.name: Single atomic commit
checklist.description: git-log.txt shows exactly one commit for this work (not multiple unrelated commits bundled, not a WIP commit)

checklist.name: No WIP/temp label
checklist.description: The commit header does NOT contain 'WIP', 'wip', 'temp', or 'tmp'
